dash-card-game.png.caption: A game test with written answers, a recording and live calls

dash-card-free.png.caption: A free web-app test (Finance, Productivity): its written answers pay nothing

dash-card-invite.png.caption: An invite-only test with access keys and an NDA

dash-card-work-waiting.png.caption: An open test with work waiting for review

dash-card-full.png.caption: A full test: 2 of 2 spots taken

dash-card-draft.png.caption: Draft: the next round, not open yet

dash-blue-box.png.caption: Payment hold: the blue box at the top of the developer dashboard

every-deleted-account.png.caption: Kai deleted their account in another tab: this tab is signed out with the red notice

every-hold-routing.webm.caption: A payment hold starts while the test page (left) and Edit (right) are open: both move to the dashboard top, where the blue box explains

post-required-mark.png.caption: The top of Post a test: “* marks the fields you have to fill in”

post-counters.png.caption: Counters on Product (up to 60), Name of this test (up to 60) and What should testers do (up to 1,000)

post-the-test.webm.caption: Posting a test: fill in the four panels, press Post the test, land on the new test's page

post-listed-find.png.caption: Anyone can join: the new test shows in testers' Find tests

post-listed-invite.png.caption: Invite only: not in Find tests; the invited tester sees it on their dashboard

post-red-required-price.png.caption: Red at the field when you leave it: required fields empty, a price under $1, spots over the limit

post-red-dates-keys.png.caption: Red when you leave the field: the deadline doesn't leave 3 days before Open until, and fewer keys than spots

post-red-checks.webm.caption: Red at the field: each box is checked when you leave it, and Post checks everything again on the server

edit-live-box.png.caption: Edit's live box sits under Save: Ana sent her written answers while Edit was open

edit-open-until.png.caption: Open until can only move later: an earlier date is red

edit-deadline.png.caption: A 30-day deadline needs Open until 3 days later: red under both fields

edit-key-in-use.png.caption: A key in use can't be added again (red)

edit-key-reported-left.png.caption: Keys reported as not working or given to a tester who left can't be added again

edit-elsewhere-field.png.caption: Another tab saved new instructions: the field updates with a blue note under it

edit-elsewhere-keys.png.caption: Keys added in another tab: the blue note under the key boxes

edit-elsewhere-save.png.caption: Save stops once: “This test changed since you opened Edit. Press Save again…”

edit-changed-elsewhere.webm.caption: Two tabs on Edit: the right tab saves new instructions and keys; the left tab's fields update with blue notes, and its Save stops once

edit-red-blue-spots-keys.png.caption: You ticked a key to remove; another tab added a spot (blue): now fewer free keys than open spots (red)

edit-red-blue-deadline.png.caption: You typed a 40-day deadline; another tab moved Open until later (blue), still too early for it (red)

edit-red-blue-keys.png.caption: You ticked one key to remove; another tab removed another (blue): the free keys no longer cover the open spots (red)

edit-three-changes.png.caption: After 3 saves that changed the steps, those fields are locked; “Changes left: 0 of 3” near Save

edit-team-stopped.webm.caption: The team stops the test while Edit is open: Save is refused and the test page's banner names the press that didn't go through

tp-overview.png.caption: Overview: title, status, badges, terms and spots, Open until, and the Edit, Alerts, Next round, End early and Stop buttons

tp-needs-you.png.caption: Needs you, grouped per person: Pay or Reject for sent work, a call waiting for its length, a dispute waiting for your side

tp-needs-dispute-call.png.caption: A dispute waiting for the developer's side, and a call that happened waiting for its length

tp-testers.png.caption: Testers: the avatar row with Ana's hover card, and one row per tester with parts sent, pay and their contract

tp-live-session.png.caption: Live session: tick testers, request times, waiting requests, booked calls (Join shows near the start) and past calls

tp-alerts.png.caption: Alerts: tick what should not stop your buttons

tp-needs-applications.png.caption: On an Approved-only test: applications to Accept or Decline, and a rejoin ask with the time they'd get back

tp-invite.png.caption: Invite testers: People you've worked with, Suggested and Find testers, then Invited

tp-invite-find.png.caption: Find testers by name: missing needs show as orange labels

tp-invite-anyway.png.caption: Invite anyway: the inline box lists the needs Dee doesn't meet

tp-next-round.png.caption: Next round: a draft copy “(round 2)”, hidden from new testers until Accept testers again

tp-end-early.png.caption: End early: tick testers, give one reason they read, then the confirm pop-up “End their work now”

tp-stop-confirm.png.caption: Stop: the confirm pop-up “Are you sure you want to stop …?”

tp-stopped.png.caption: Stopped: the Stopped label and the stopped line; the overview buttons are gone and Live session says no calls can be booked

tp-stopped-tester.png.caption: The tester's page after Stop: the stopped line says what they can still do (phone)

tp-live-box.webm.caption: The live box: Ana (right, phone) sends her answers and switches to the new terms; the developer's box updates and See their contract scrolls to her row

tp-stop-once-pay.png.caption: Stop-once on Pay: Ben sent his answers since the page loaded, listed under the button

tp-stop-once.webm.caption: Stop-once: Ben (right, phone) sends his answers while the developer presses Pay for Ana; Pay stops once and lists the change, the second press goes ahead

tp-stop-once-stop.png.caption: Stop-once after a pop-up: Cam left while the Stop pop-up was open; the press didn't go through and the change shows under Stop

tp-stop-once-invite.png.caption: Invite stops once: Fay removed iPhone and iPad from her profile after the page loaded

tp-team-paused.webm.caption: The team pauses the test: End early is refused (“you can only stop it”) and the banner explains

tp-team-stopped.webm.caption: The team stops the test while a call is being requested: the request is refused, the page moves to the top and the banner names the press that didn't go through
